title: Block Movement / stack / 32029
description: Which sequence produces the entire final stack?
question: Use the 3 x 2 x 3 board. Each pair shows the same stack from opposite sides. Coordinates (x,y,z) follow the axes, starting at zero. Move the cube at the named current cell one unit. An occupied target swaps with the mover. An empty elevated target needs support immediately before the move. After each step, settle every column downward, preserving its order. Equal colors are interchangeable. Which sequence produces the entire final stack?

answer.explanation: gold (1, 0, 0) to (0, 0, 0), red falls from (1, 0, 1) to (1, 0, 0). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with red. Then cyan (2, 0, 0) to (1, 0, 0), exchanging with red. Every displayed constraint matches.
